definitions: Lacking the power to perform a function; not efficient or robust.
Lacking in force, persuasiveness, or intensity.
Lacking in moral strength or willpower.
Lacking in substance or quality; poor.
Denoting a verb, noun, or other part of speech that forms inflections by means of suffixes rather than by changes in the stem vowel (e.g. walk, walked rather than sing, sang).
Denoting a solution, mixture, or drink that is diluted or has a low concentration of a particular substance.
examples: She was too weak to stand.
He had a moment of weak resolve.
